reading.body:
Studio Delta Srl is a probable mistag, an Italian professional-services office whose office IT was labeled a data center, and it carries zero megawatts.

The pattern is a naming one. "Studio" in Italian commonly denotes a practice in architecture, engineering, accounting, or design, and "Srl" is the standard suffix for a limited-liability company. The point has no operator, no website, no city, and a capacity of zero megawatts, which is consistent with a small office rather than a hosting business. The determination rests on the name and the tag review, not on confirmed business activity, because search quota ran out before the firm's specialty could be checked.

For AI, the distinction that matters is between counting facilities and counting power. An entry like this can raise a tally of data centers without adding a single megawatt of load, so site counts and capacity counts should never be read as the same number. The binding constraint on AI scaling is electricity and the buildings that draw it, and a mislabeled office contributes to neither.

What this does not establish is what Studio Delta Srl actually does, or how many other entries in the same inventory share the problem. A single point in northern Italy, 19.5 miles from Parma Airport, is not evidence about Italian data-center capacity in either direction.
